nodes.name: Ranger_VineField
nodes.text: Summon a vine field at target location. Targets in the area take $hit1$ and become $effect:Status_Root$ for 2 seconds, every 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Ranger_Strider
nodes.text: Increases ground movement speed of target by 12% + 0.2% per Ranger level.  Maximum 20%.

nodes.name: Ranger_CallOfTheWild
nodes.text: Remove all movement impairing effects and increase movement speed by 20% for 8 seconds.  Snares and Roots effects applied to the caster are ignored.

nodes.name: Ranger_RainingDeath
nodes.text: Fires a rain of arrows in a wide area in front of you, dealing $hit1$ twice to every target within range.

nodes.name: Ranger_Disengage
nodes.text: Quickly strike enemies in front of you while backflipping in the opposite direction. Enemies hit by the strike take $hit1$ and gain 1 stack of $effect:Status_Snared$ for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_BearTrap_Multitrap
nodes.text: Bear Trap now has 3 charges, but the cooldown is increased by 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_BearTrap_Trapslinger
nodes.text: Bear Trap becomes a thrown projectile and arms itself instantly upon landing. Deals double damage when triggered.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_ScatterShot_Concentrated
nodes.text: Scatter Shot becomes a held ability. After being fully charged, you instead fire a single projectile in a forward line that pierces through enemies dealing $hit:Ranger_Scattershot_Hit_Charged$.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_ScatterShot_Multi
nodes.text: Scatter Shot has an additional charge.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_Disengage_Reinvigorating
nodes.text: When you hit one or more enemies with Disengage, its cooldown is refreshed and can be used again. This can only occur once per cooldown period.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_Headshot_Mortal
nodes.text: Headshot deals 50% additional damage to targets below 50% of their maximum health.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_Headshot_Refreshing
nodes.text: Headshot refunds 4 seconds of its cooldown when it hits a Marked target.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_Snipe_Heartseeking
nodes.text: Snipe has an 30% increased chance to critically hit against enemies hit beyond 20 meters.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_Snipe_Hasting
nodes.text: Gain 20% increased attack speed for 5 seconds after casting Snipe.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_VineField_Ensnaring
nodes.text: Enemies are snared while within Vine Field's area of effect.

nodes.name: Ranger_Passive_ThunderingShot_Explosive
nodes.text: The arrow transforms into an explosive shot that deals 25% more damage and also hits enemies in an area around the target.

nodes.name: Ranger_Camouflage
nodes.text: You become harder to see and cannot be directly targeted. The further you are from an enemy, the more difficult you are to spot. Any outgoing combat actions cancel this effect, as well as incoming damage or other negative effects.

nodes.name: Mage_Combust
nodes.text: Instantly combust your target, dealing $hit1$ and applying $effect:Status_Conflagrating$ if they are $effect:Status_BurningStat.hide$

nodes.name: Mage_ElementalEmpowerment
nodes.text: You become empowered by your last cast elemental ability. Your weapon combo finishers apply a stack of $effect:Status_BurningStat$, $effect:Status_Chilled$, or $effect:Status_Electrified$ to targets hit, based on your current empowerment. Additionally, your combo finishers reset the cooldown of Frostbolt, Fireball, and Lightning Strike.

nodes.name: Mage_FlashFreeze
nodes.text: Quickly unleash a blast of icy wind at target location, dealing $hit1$, and applying $effect:Status_Frozen$ to targets with $effect:Status_Chilled.hide$.

nodes.name: Mage_Slumber
nodes.text: Applies the sleeping condition to targets affected within a small area around the primary target, rendering them unable to move or take any action. Any damage dealt to a sleeping target will break the effect. Duration is reduced by 20% for each additional target hit, to a minimum of 40% of base duration.

nodes.name: Mage_ArcaneEye
nodes.text: Conjure a magical eye that reveals any camouflaged enemies within a 20 meter radius around you to you and all party members over the next 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Mage_Passive_Fuse
nodes.text: Your applied $effect:Status_BurningStat$ statuses are 50% more powerful when applied to targets with $effect:Status_Shocked$.

nodes.name: Mage_Passive_LightningStrike_Amplified
nodes.text: Lightning Strike applies $effect:Status_Shocked$ at up to twice the normal duration, depending on how long Lightning Strike was charged.

nodes.name: Mage_Passive_ChainLightning_Earth
nodes.text: Casting Chain Lightning on a primary target with $effect:Status_Staggered.hide$ causes the attack to trigger twice.

nodes.name: Mage_Passive_MagmaField_Pyromania
nodes.text: Upon cast completion, an additional Magma Field spawns under your character. But you also become afflicted by $effect:Status_BurningStat$ at $hit:Mage_MagmaField_Pyromania$ power.

nodes.name: Mage_Passive_ConeOfCold_Tempestuous
nodes.text: Cone of Cold pushes back enemies.

nodes.name: Cleric_SoothingGlow
nodes.text: Apply $effect1$ to target ally. $charges$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Deliverance
nodes.text: Held ability: Charges up healing energy that heals a target ally upon release, scaling in power the longer it is charged, up to $hit1.max$

nodes.name: Cleric_BlessWeapon
nodes.text: Imbues your target's weapon with radiant light, granting them $effect1.inline$.

choice.text: Consume Divine Power to instantly complete the remaining cast time of any healing spell currently being cast. The amount of Divine Power consumed is proportional to the amount of cast time remaining upon activation.

nodes.name: Cleric_WingsOfSalvation

nodes.name: Cleric_HealingTouch
nodes.text: Heal target ally in melee range for $hit1$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Purify
nodes.text: Remove up to 3 dispellable debuffs from an ally.

nodes.name: Cleric_DivineFlare
nodes.text: Place a targeted area on the ground that heals all targets after several seconds. Heals for $hit:Cleric_DivineFlare_EndHit$ divided amongst each target hit.

nodes.name: Cleric_Barrier
nodes.text: Sacrifice 25% of your maximum health and apply that much temporary health to target ally for 10 seconds. Does not stack.

nodes.name: Cleric_DefiantLight
nodes.text: Heal target ally for 50% of their maximum health over 10 seconds. If that target would receive fatal damage while under this effect, this effect is consumed and prevents that target's death, healing them for 25% of their maximum health instead.

nodes.name: Cleric_Smite
nodes.text: Smite your target. Occurs instantly in melee range, dealing $hit1$. Otherwise has a cast time and deals $hit2$ if ranged. Also applies $hit3$ $effect:Status_BurningStat$.

nodes.text: Applies $hit1.apply0$ to target enemy.{skill:Cleric:Cleric_Passive_Condemn_Infernal:{effect:Cleric_Passive_Condemn_Infernal.inline}}

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_Deliverance_Redemptive
nodes.text: Deliverance heals more based on the missing health percentage of the target.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_Mend_Plentiful
nodes.text: Mend has two additional charges.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_BlessWeapon_Bountiful
nodes.text: Whenever an ally attacks whose weapon you have blessed, you also gain $effect:Cleric_BlessWeapon_Mana$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_ChainsOfRestraint_Binding
nodes.text: Chains of Restraint's final tick applies $effect:Cleric_ChainsOfRestraint_Stun$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_ConsecratingWave_Restorative
nodes.text: Consecrating Wave additionally heals you and up to 10 allies for $hit:Cleric_ConsecratingWave_AllyHit$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_DivineFlare_Retributive
nodes.text: Divine Flare also deals damage to enemies in its area of effect when it detonates. Deals $hit:Cleric_DivineFlare_EndHit_Retributive$ divided amongst each target hit.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_DivineFlare_Shielding
nodes.text: Divine Flare applies $effect:Cleric_DivineFlare_Shielding$ to allies inside its area of effect before detonation.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_Mend_Escalating
nodes.text: Mend's healing is increased each time it is used in quick succession.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_WingsOfSalvation_Unyielding
nodes.text: Wings of Salvation breaks all hard crowd control effects on the caster.

nodes.name: Cleric_Passive_BlessWeapon_Righteous
nodes.text: While Bless Weapon is active, weapon attacks have a 20% chance to proc additional $hit:Cleric_BlessWeapon_Proc_Righteous$ and apply $hit:Cleric_BlessWeapon_Proc_Righteous_Burning$ $effect:Status_BurningStat$.

nodes.name: Cleric_Resurrect
nodes.text: Resurrect target ally with 25% of their max health and mana.

nodes.name: Tank_Charge_Knockback
nodes.text: Adds a knockback to targets in the way of your Charge.

nodes.name: Tank_Tomahawk
nodes.text: Throw a Tomahawk at target enemy, dealing $hit1$. Deals 50% more damage to targets hit from behind.

nodes.name: Tank_Tomahawk_Trip
nodes.text: Tomahawk applies $effect:Status_Tripped$ to the target if it hits them from behind.

nodes.name: Tank_Taunt
nodes.text: Taunt target enemy, generating threat equal to your maximum health and applying $effect:Status_Humiliation$.

nodes.name: Tank_IndomitableSpirit
nodes.text: Gain $effect1$.

nodes.name: Tank_ShakeItOff
nodes.text: Activate to instantly restore 50% of all damage taken in the past 4 seconds. Always heals for at least 10% of your maximum HP.

nodes.name: Tank_RushOfCourage
nodes.text: You feel a surge of resolve. Gain $hit1:statmod0$.

nodes.name: Tank_AbsorbtionField
nodes.text: You and allies that enter the absorption field are granted an absorption shield equal to 50% of the caster's maximum health. This can only be applied to any specific target once per 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Tank_Wall
nodes.text: Summons a glorious Wall at the target location. Obstructs movement and blocks projectiles.  Stuns targets that come into contact with it for 3 seconds.  The wall can be mantled.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Grit_Supernatural
nodes.text: Grit also increases magical mitigation by the same amount.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Vengeance_Relentless
nodes.text: Vengeance deals 15% more damage per stack of Vengeance on the caster.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Protect_Extended
nodes.text: Your protected target can be 10m further away before the link begins to break.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Pulverize_Punishing
nodes.text: Pulverize and Desolate have 100% critical hit chance against snared or recently tripped enemies.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Reflect_Oppressive
nodes.text: If Reflect successfully reflects damage to an attacker, that attacker is also tripped.

nodes.name: Tank_Passive_Reflect_Refreshing
nodes.text: Reflect restores mana equal to the damage dealt by the reflected hit, up to 20% of the caster's total mana.

nodes.name: Tank_IronAura
nodes.text: Toggled Ability: Increases Physical and Magical Mitigation by 10% for all party members within 10 meters.

nodes.name: Fighter_LethalBlow
nodes.text: Perform a powerful descending strike upon target enemy, dealing $hit1.min$ plus additional damage based on the amount of missing health, up to a total maximum of $hit1.max$.

nodes.name: Fighter_Maim
nodes.text: Perform a powerful melee strike in a short forward cone, dealing $hit1$ to all targets hit, plus 50% additional damage to recently tripped targets.

nodes.name: Fighter_Blitz
nodes.text: Charge directly toward target enemy, dealing $hit:Fighter_Blitz$ to the target on arrival.

nodes.name: Fighter_Wallop
nodes.text: Spend half of current Combat Momentum to deal $hit1.min$ plus additional damage depending on how much Combat Momentum was spent, up to a maximum total of $hit1.max$.

nodes.name: Fighter_KnockOut
nodes.text: Knock out target enemy, putting them to sleep for 10 seconds. Any damage breaks the effect.

nodes.name: Fighter_LungingAssault
nodes.text: Spend 15 Combat Momentum to lunge in a direction a short distance and perform an upward swing upon arrival, dealing $hit1$ to enemies in front of you. You are immune to hard crowd control effects while performing this ability.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_Brutality
nodes.text: Overpower and Brutal Cleave apply 10 Wound stacks to enemies hit.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_LethalBlow_Consuming
nodes.text: Lethal Blow returns 50% of overkill damage dealt as health and mana.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_LethalBlow_Reinvigorating

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_Whirlwind_Climactic
nodes.text: Perform a final swing in an area in front of you after ending Whirlwind's channel, dealing $hit:Fighter_Whirlwind_2$ and generating 5-10 Combat Momentum based on number of targets hit.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_Whirlwind_Overdrive
nodes.text: After completing the final spin, you may continue spinning at maximum speed while rapidly depleting your Momentum. Ends after Momentum is fully depleted or after stopping the channel.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_BattleCry_Unyielding
nodes.text: Battle Cry breaks all disabling effects on the caster.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_Berserk_Reinvigorating
nodes.text: Exert additionally refeshes all ability cooldowns by 1% per point of Combat Momentum the caster has upon activation.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_LungingAssault_Recharging
nodes.text: Lunging Assault gains an additional charge and generates 5 additional Combat Momentum when dealing damage to one or more enemies.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_ArtOfWar
nodes.text: Switching forms no longer triggers cooldowns or costs Combat Momentum.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_Blitz_Raging
nodes.text: Blitz generates 20 Combat Momentum.

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_FormOfFluidity_Regenerative

nodes.name: Fighter_Passive_FormOfCelerity_Meditative
nodes.text: Form of Celerity regenerates 0.01% of your maximum health per second per point of Combat Momentum you have.
